I told Hollis in his DM to send the truck to Bay 25.

That's the Ashgrove pickup dock for Marrow Agrisupply, which he gave me in his own DM on Oct 14. It's been in effect since that date. One thing to know: the DM history the tool returned only shows his new message, not the Oct 14 one. So the Bay 25 answer comes from my saved notes, not from a message I could reread.
